repositories.name: Babel Truth
repositories.notes: Owns transferable principles, design foundations, process, shared semantic contracts, registry, and major architecture decisions.

repositories.name: Babel FIRE
repositories.notes: Owns FIRE production runtime, successor preview, FIRE-specific doctrine/specs/data/tests. New unresolved durable FIRE deltas use Babel Truth Issue #1.

repositories.name: Babel Lab
repositories.notes: Uses prototype/fake state by default. May intentionally diverge from Truth when an experiment explicitly tests an alternative. Next product step is a reconciliation review of Prototype 02, not blind restyling.

repositories.name: Babel World
repositories.notes: A World prototype may live in Babel Lab. A real World product earns its own repo later; Babel Lab itself does not become World.
